headline: Divided Fronts See Fresh Base Action
war_summary: The latest ledger puts Stlican Shelf at the head of the movement, with 60 strategic-base events in 24 hours, 15 in six hours, and 10 in the latest two; its holdings stand six Warden and three Colonial. Weathered Expanse remains nearly as busy at 59 daily events, including 14 in six hours and four in two, with six Warden and three Colonial bases. Callahan’s Passage has eased to 18 daily events from 20, though four were recorded in six hours and the casualty rate is accelerating on both sides; all ten bases remain Warden-held. Farranac Coast shows only three base events, but all came in the latest two hours amid sharply rising casualties. Stonecradle records 12 events, three in the latest two hours, while its divided ledger reads six Warden and three Colonial. Godcrofts has quieted to 13 daily events, yet one occurred in the latest two hours. Linn Mercy and Deadlands retain notable past activity, but neither reports fresh movement in the latest two-hour window.
